data_fields.name: blood_per_damage
data_fields.donor_constant: 3/2 in code (1.5 percent points per damage); comment says 2/3

data_fields.name: blood_cap_at_hp
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: min(damage, HP before the hit)

best_idea: A hit sets its blood extent from the damage, capped at the HP before the hit, and the stain spreads one neighbour-step per generation with the chance falling by a fixed step, so a finishing blow on a weak target leaves a smaller pool.
decision_why: We want the stain to say how hard the hit was, and this is a cheap data-driven rule that keeps decals bounded at 375 wide. Adapt: pick one formula (the donor comment and code disagree), seed the stain RNG for replay, add a cell budget, never re-roll a cell. Reject the blocking flash loop.
acceptance: At 375 wide a 40-damage hit on a 100-HP creature leaves a stain up to 3 steps out from the wound; a 5-damage hit spreads one step only (each of the four neighbours at 22%); a fixed-seed unit test asserts the same stain cells on replay and never more than 40 cells.
